assertions.name: A4_no_ordering_straddles_q0
assertions.source: 0 of 6 windows contain h(q_0); all lie in [0.4339, 0.5698]

description: Answers whether the crossing-branch parameters beta are forced by the quark content: they are. pyhecke.atom.nucleon_gen_chains types each of the three quark-pair crossings by flavour — uu -> sigma (beta 0), dd -> sigma^-1 (beta 1), ud -> average (beta 1/2) — with pairs (0,1),(0,2) on generator 0 and (1,2) on generator 1, yielding proton (0,1/2,1/2) and neutron (1/2,1/2,1) with zero freedom. The same template map types the inter-nucleon crossings (pp -> 0, nn -> 1, pn -> 1/2), so one rule applies at two scales. The only residual freedom is the quark ordering, which picks which pair sits on generator 1; it gives four classes with transitions 0.477184637, NONE, 0.569840291 and 0.433865897, and NO proton/neutron pairing straddles q_0 — every window lies in [0.4339, 0.5698] while h(q_0) = 0.20906. The last apparent dial is therefore closed. The substantive finding is a scope error it exposes: atom_gen_chains carries C(A,2) inter-nucleon crossings (1, 3, 6 extra on generator 0 for 2H, 3H, 4He) plus Z electron crossings, and the aggregation LP of nfold_ip_coupling_duality_gap_probe used only v_p and v_n, with no inter-nucleon term at all.
caveats: SCOPE BOUND ON THE EARLIER BINDING RESULTS, not a retraction. The dual-vertex hysteresis, the rank-one dual and the two transition points are correct statements about the per-nucleon LP that was actually built. What A5 establishes is that this LP omits the C(A,2) inter-nucleon bonds and the Z electron crossings the corpus's own atom_gen_chains includes, so 'binding is zero at q_0' has only ever been demonstrated for a nucleus with its bonds left out.

The flavour rule itself is a convention in one respect: it fixes u <-> forward and d <-> inverse rather than the reverse. Swapping that orientation maps proton (0,1/2,1/2) -> (1,1/2,1/2) and neutron (1/2,1/2,1) -> (1/2,1/2,0), i.e. exactly onto the two alternative ordering classes already enumerated in A3/A4 — so the swap changes no conclusion here: those classes are covered and none of them straddles q_0 either.

A container reset mid-investigation dropped this session onto a different branch (claude/omegaorder-exponent-group), whose pyhecke gives a different transition for the same betas (0.679 rather than 0.477). Everything reported here is computed on claude/mt7r-archimedean-eval-2026-08-24, and A6 re-verifies the previous probe's two transition values to 1e-9 as a guard.
